name: Sid
summary: Sid is a contact from a group chat who reached out to get his Instagram account @secretsocietyhospitality reactivated after it was suspended/deactivated for alleged copyright violations (DMCA-style third-party claims). He agreed to the price, shared login credentials, and the appeal was submitted on 2026-10-26. He supplied the Meta copyright-removal email with the report number when asked; work is in progress, so follow up on whether the reactivation went through and on payment collection.
key_facts: Introduced himself as 'Sid from the gc' (group chat); addressed the phone owner as Vivek
Account: Instagram @secretsocietyhospitality (Secret Society, a Texas hospitality/nightlife brand; recovery email texassecretsociety@gmail.com)
Suspended by Meta for IP/copyright policy violations; appeal deadline shown as April 18, 2027
Had already filed an appeal himself two days before reaching out (~2026-10-19)
Copyright claim email found: Report #1065113349381398, rights owner 'Alexander Mahone', jjy44844@outlook.com, re a reel uploaded 2026-08-05
Shared IG login credentials on 2026-10-26 and completed the requested step, then PM'd
Scheduling was difficult: he's in CST, travels/has gigs, prefers late-night calls; several missed calls between 10-21 and 10-26
Price was agreed but the amount is not visible in the thread
services_discussed: Zoom walkthrough of the recovery process
